window_selection: Calendar diagnostics chosen before this replay's returns; NOT unseen crash validation or representative annual alpha
fill_policy: Deterministic full-fill conditional approximation; no venue capacity, partial-fill, protective-latency or liquidity qualification
intrabar_policy: SL-first on ambiguity including entry minute; adverse gap open for stop, no target gap improvement; do not interpolate paths
funding_policy: Signed archived 8h rates applied at actual settlement, candle-open not mark-price proxy; fixed prior allowance for admission, never future-rate admission
settlement_order: Existing position settles before same-open exits; entries after same-open settlement; unknown intrabar exits settle no later than bar close
simultaneous_entry_order: Fixed universe order; risk never nets across long and short
drawdown_policy: Closed-minute MTM and conservative within-minute adverse-envelope bound, not tick-level observed equity

llm_arms.reason: No point-in-time news/provider responses or measured historical completion/cost; pretrained future-event contamination
